description.en: Side chat panel for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: hover the browser's right edge to open a chat column alongside the main conversation, with streaming replies, collapsible reasoning, markdown tables, and in-panel model/effort switching.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的侧边聊天面板：鼠标悬停浏览器右边缘即打开与主对话并排的聊天栏，支持流式输出、可折叠思考过程、Markdown 表格，以及面板内切换模型与推理等级。
